payload.title: Story-job gate: adopt writing-effective-stories at assignment and editor select
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-27: the Limatus writing-effective-stories skill (.cursor/skills/writing-effective-stories/SKILL.md on Limatus main) is central to Anthus marketing. Make it a stage gate, not a reading. Assignment stage: the charter names the story's job (who I am, why I'm here, vision, teaching, values in action, I know what you're thinking) and the sourced moment it is built on; no manufactured people, events, quotes, or numbers; thin material becomes a concise factual example. Editor select: check for a clear job, a real source, a visible turning point, and a takeaway proportionate to the evidence. Client-acquisition overlay: opening is a teaching story or values-in-action scene, closing section is a vision story of the client's month six, the engage box is why-we're-here. Doctrine and skill edits in this repo go through a pull request per AGENTS.md; the Limatus profile gets the same four checks as findings. This is a process story, not an article.
